PROBLEM: Core PR #649 CI red on Verify-dist-is-up-to-date: lane commit d434226e changed CLI src without rebuilding cli/dist. Regenerate cli/dist from current lane source so the dist check passes; verifier files (substrate-verify.ts + test) are unaffected and must not be modified.
SUCCESS: cli/dist rebuilt via the repo-canonical build command; the dist-freshness check passes locally; lane HEAD amended or follow-up committed and force-pushed to PR #649; new head SHA reported on bead xtrm-pc7hs. CI dist job green (or verified-equivalent local check green if CI has not rerun yet).
SCOPE: Lane xt/6qu9-core @ 4235ae5c in worktree /home/dawid/dev/core/.xtrm/worktrees/core-xt-pi-6qu9-core. Build + dist artifacts + lane commits only. Read the dist-check job definition first to run the exact check it runs.
NON_GOALS: No source changes beyond what the build regenerates; no verifier edits; no PR merge (explicitly forbidden); no rebase (already on main 9e3d78dd).
CONSTRAINTS: TMPDIR=/var/tmp, lane-owned scratch only. Use the repo's own build script (package.json) for the rebuild — no hand-edits to dist. Keep the same PR lineage (amend or stacked commit + force-with-lease push to xt/6qu9-core).
VALIDATION: Local dist-freshness check green; git status shows only intended dist changes; 58/58 substrate suite still green after rebuild; PR #649 shows new head.
OUTPUT: New head SHA on bead xtrm-pc7hs + executor report; coordinator relays SHA to epic coordinator.
SCRUTINY: HIGH
